title: Gömülü Rüyalar Ülkesi
author: Kasım Hasan Ünal
description: The Land of Buried Dreams is a haunting literary novel where memory, guilt, faith, and imagination become inseparable. Haunted by the childhood death of his younger brother and unable to sleep for seven years, Efraim struggles to escape a tightly knit religious neighborhood fractured by political divisions, buried secrets, and competing myths. As a stray dog regarded by many residents as a blessed guardian, is brutally murdered and suspicion spreads through the community, his search for freedom leads him into a world where photography, love, storytelling, and dreams offer the only refuge from reality. Drawing on the rich traditions of Ottoman and Persian miniatures, Sufi storytelling, and modern Turkish literature, including echoes of Ahmet Hamdi Tanpınar's A Mind at Peace (Huzur), The Land of Buried Dreams is an immersive literary work that explores how individuals and societies survive through the stories they inherit, create, and conceal. It is the story of a man trying to survive the past, and of a community struggling to reconcile the myths it lives by with the truths it would rather forget.
